endorsements.label: [PANEL] Free Your Mind: The NMRC Info/Warez
endorsements.description: New years bring new threats. Laws such as the DMCA, PATRIOT and DSEA are threatening hackers to the core. But instead of lecturing on what the underground could be doing to counter, NMRC will lead by example and present what they have been working on for the past year. New tools, new techniques, new information, and a new operating system! All open source, all full disclosure, all with security and privacy in mind.
